Round 2 · Studio Bellweather · Confidential

The brief, in one sentence

"Make Northwind feel like the most quietly confident shipping logistics company in North America — without losing the trust we've built over forty years."

  • Audience: enterprise procurement, ages 35–60
  • Three competitors went neon. We are not going neon.
  • Tone: warm, exact, slightly dry
02 / 04

Wordmark direction

The new Northwind wordmark uses a custom-drawn slab serif inspired by 1970s shipping manifests, but optically corrected for screen rendering at small sizes.

The lowercase 'd' was redrawn to terminate at a 12° angle — a quiet nod to a wind vane, our heritage mark.

It works at 12px in a CRM and at 12 meters on a truck.

03 / 04

What we're asking for today

Three decisions, in order of cost-to-reverse:

  • Direction approval (cheap to revisit)
  • Color system commitment (medium cost)
  • Greenlight to begin truck livery production (expensive)
